updates.note: Management stated FY26 spending is around INR 1,200-1,300 crore.
updates.quote: FY26 is already underway, that would involve spending of around INR 100 crore, bringing the total to approximately INR 1,200–1,300 crore.

new_promises.statement: Total capex outlay for FY27 is expected to be around INR 2,500 crore.
new_promises.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

new_promises.statement: The MIBK/MIBC project is targeted for commissioning within Q4 FY26.
new_promises.quote: The MIBK/ MIBC project is progressing well and is targeted for commissioning within this quarter.
new_promises.speaker: Maulik Mehta

new_promises.statement: The polycarbonate project is targeted to be onstream by December 2027.
new_promises.quote: December 2027 is the timeline we had discussed for being onstream.
new_promises.speaker: Maulik Mehta
